name: Awe
description:
*You project psionic energy out to a creature and take on a new visage in their mind.*

**Heroic Ability** — Psionic, Ranged, Strike, Telepathy — Main action

**Cost:** 3 Clarity

**Distance:** Ranged 12   **Target:** One ally or enemy

**2d10 + 2**

- **11 or less:** 5 psychic damage; I < 0 frightened (save ends)
- **12-16:** 8 psychic damage; I < 1 frightened (save ends)
- **17+:** 11 psychic damage; I < 2 frightened (save ends)

**Effect:** If you target an ally, they gain 6 temporary Stamina, and they can end one effect on them that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn. If you target an enemy, you make a power roll.
